# Eventbrite

> > Event discovery and ticketing platform connecting people to local experiences, classes, workshops, and community gatherings.

Eventbrite is a global event management and ticketing platform that helps organizers promote and sell tickets to events ranging from professional training (Outlook, CSPO certification, AI bootcamps) to community festivals and wellness gatherings. The platform serves as a marketplace for discovering local events across various categories and locations.

## Key Topics

- Event Discovery
- Online Ticketing
- Live Training & Workshops
- Community Events
- Professional Development
- Certification Programs
- Wellness Festivals
- Virtual Events
- In-Person Gatherings
- Event Management
- Local Experiences
- Educational Workshops
- Tax Strategy
- Scrum Certification
- AI & Data Science Training

## Event Discovery

- [Eventbrite - Discover the Best Local Events & Things to Do](https://eventbrite.com): Homepage for discovering local events across US cities and categories

## Professional Development & Training

- [AI Accelerator Bootcamp : AI Curious to AI Builders](https://eventbrite.com/e/ai-accelerator-bootcamp-ai-curious-to-ai-builders-tickets-1984447149845): 6-hour AI bootcamp by Decoding Data Science for building AI apps
- [CSPO - BUR | Live Online | Certified Scrum Product Owner](https://eventbrite.com/e/cspo-bur-live-online-certified-scrum-product-owner-tickets-1984730497345): Live online CSPO certification workshop by Powered By Teams
- [Outlook Beginner - LIVE](https://eventbrite.com/e/outlook-beginner-live-tickets-1983975620488): Live online Outlook beginner tutorial by Learn Skills Daily
- [Outlook Advanced - LIVE](https://eventbrite.com/e/outlook-advanced-live-tickets-1983978202210): Live online Outlook advanced tutorial by Learn Skills Daily

## Community & Wellness Events

- [Health Sphere 2026](https://eventbrite.com/e/health-sphere-2026-tickets-1984710702137): Community wellness festival in London by The Health Hub
- [Beautiful Minds: A Community Wellbeing Festival](https://eventbrite.com/e/beautiful-minds-a-community-wellbeing-festival-tickets-1984229574070): Free community wellness festival at Compton College in California
- [Parents & Carers Support Session - Resilience and Managing Exam Stress](https://eventbrite.com/e/parents-carers-support-session-resilience-and-managing-exam-stress-tickets-1984633258501): Online parent support session on exam stress by City of London Corp

## Business & Finance Workshops

- [Not Another Webinar: A Hands-On Tax Strategy You'll Actually Use](https://eventbrite.com/e/copy-of-not-another-webinar-a-hands-on-tax-strategy-youll-actually-use-tickets-1984715932782): Online hands-on tax strategy workshop with money mapping framework
